title: Indian-American leader urges California Guv Newsom to run for President
description:
Indian-American community leader Ajay Jain Bhutoria met California Governor Gavin Newsom and urged him to run for US President in 2028, assuring support from the South Asian communities.
Bhutoria, a member of the California Board for Professional Engineers, Land Surveyors, and Geologists, met Newsom in Sacramento on Monday and urged him to formally announce his candidacy.
"America needs a leader with vision, courage and a proven record of getting things done, and Governor Newsom is that leader," Bhutoria said.
The 59-year-old Newsom is considered to be among the potential candidates for the US presidency in 2028. He told a media outlet that he would make a decision on launching a presidential bid in early January.
Bhutoria, a former adviser to President Joe Biden, said Newsom has led California through some of its toughest challenges and stood up for every community.
